title: CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data
abstract: arXiv:2611.28369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during training, and identifies the learning deficiencies responsible. We introduce a causal world-model setup, for which, we characterize the Bayes-optimal predictor under the causal view of the data. We then prove that, a function that distills its predictions to non-causal views of data, when realized under Occam's Razor, recovers the true causal predictor. Based on this analysis we propose CausalNTP, a practical training algorithm that approximates this theoretical recipe and trains transformers to depend only the causally relevant tokens in left-context. Empirically in the world-model setup, CausalNTP achieves out-of-distribution generalization that vanilla NTP cannot due to its theoretical limit

translated_title: CausalNTP：一种在噪声训练数据下进行因果下一个词预测的世界模型方案
translated_abstract: 本文表明，使用下一个词预测（NTP）和梯度下降训练的Transformer网络，无论训练期间词元的因果顺序如何，都无法学会仅使用左侧上下文中因果相关的词元来进行预测，并识别了导致这一问题的学习缺陷。我们引入了一个因果世界模型设置，并针对该设置刻画了数据因果视角下的贝叶斯最优预测器。然后我们证明，一个将其预测蒸馏到数据非因果视角的函数，在奥卡姆剃刀原则下实现时，能够恢复真实的因果预测器。基于这一分析，我们提出了CausalNTP，这是一种逼近该理论方案的实用训练算法，它训练Transformer仅依赖于左侧上下文中因果相关的词元。在实验中，在世界模型设置下，CausalNTP实现了分布外泛化能力，而原始NTP由于其理论限制无法做到这一点。
tldr: 本文提出CausalNTP训练算法，通过因果世界模型设置和奥卡姆剃刀原则，使Transformer仅依赖左侧上下文中因果相关的词元进行预测，从而实现原始NTP因理论限制而无法达到的分布外泛化能力。
